title: Data enrichment Round 2: marine engines (Mercury history, global manufacturers), boat parts anatomy, yacht size classes, beat-Wikipedia analysis
description: Second wave of the authorized enrichment loop. (1) Full Mercury Marine history from Kiekhaefer 1939 to current, tied into offshore powerboat racing (extends corpus docs 03/04). (2) Global marine engine manufacturer directory — outboard/inboard/sterndrive/diesel/electric — deeper than Wikipedia; feeds the engine node type (currently 16 nodes, 1 powered_by edge). (3) Boat/yacht parts & anatomy dataset. (4) Yacht vs superyacht vs megayacht vs gigayacht classification dataset with thresholds + examples. (5) Analytical lane: dataset-vs-Wikipedia comparison, ranked missing-topic ideas. Business rule recorded: this data tier stays free; if data quality is #1, monetize with a single ad.
acceptance_criteria: Mercury Marine + offshore powerboat racing engine history researched into research/round2/ with sources, covering 1939-present eras, racing classes, and current product lines
Global engine manufacturer directory: 40+ brands with parent company, country, founded, engine types, power ranges, notable models, segment
Boat parts anatomy dataset: 100+ parts with category, location, description, vessel applicability
Size classification dataset: yacht/superyacht/megayacht/gigayacht definitions with length/GT thresholds, sourced, plus example vessels
Beat-Wikipedia analysis doc: side-by-side coverage comparison and ranked list of missing datasets/ideas
Mapper support for new datasets (engine enrichment, parts, classes) designed and implemented with tests; ingest green; completeness score improves and is recorded
